protocol.selection: Highest mean AUROC across the same four training-only facility-grouped folds. No model selection from legacy-test results.
protocol.calibration: Each model: standardise raw margins on calibration data, then logistic calibration on 518 separate records / 94 facilities.
protocol.cutoff: Each model: maximise balanced accuracy on 1057 other records / 95 facilities; ties prefer sensitivity.
protocol.legacy_test: 1739 previously examined records / 236 facilities. Exploratory reused comparison; not independent validation.
protocol.feature_schema: history-v2; identical preprocessing protocol for every family, fitted within each training fold.
protocol.candidate_scope: One fixed configuration per family; this is not exhaustive hyperparameter optimisation.
protocol.internal_validation: No row-wise early-stopping validation and no SVC probability=True internal calibration.
protocol.export_policy: Aggregate metrics only. No patient rows, individual predictions, support vectors or nearest-neighbour training data exported.
protocol.deployment: Active model is not replaced by this experiment.

selected_vs_active_paired_auc.limitation: Reused cohort; conditions on fitted models and excludes selection uncertainty.

limitations: One fixed configuration per family; results do not establish the globally best algorithm.
Repeated development and previously inspected legacy test; no independent validation.
Shared numerical/one-hot representation; CatBoost native categorical handling was not tested.
CV spread is not a confidence interval. Selection uncertainty is not included in the paired bootstrap.
Research-only comparison. Active application model was not changed.
